acceptanceCriteria: Retain a frozen bounded fixture and repeatable public-CLI recipe covering current, stale and deleted evidence and unchanged obligation/historical-verification attribution.

Run fresh-session recovery with checkpoint and competent structured-note arms; retain result identities, task outcome, observed command/read counts and latency, with unknown cost/token metrics explicit.

Keep FPK-V0-020..026 and SESSION-V0-001..016 boundaries, record limitations and independent review, bind/seal CEM, publish a verified draft PR; leave ticket open pending any required landing/completion support.
body:
Owner requested implementation of the OpenRig comparison on 2026-09-29. First scoped slice: a reproducible experimental recovery pilot on the existing corvint-checkpoint/0 contract, with immutable evidence, explicit current/stale/missing outcomes, prior verification kept historical, and a fresh builder-to-reviewer session boundary. No daemon, new checkpoint wire, implicit transcript recovery, promotion or savings claim. Follow-on task-state UI/integration requires evidence from this slice. Existing V1-0199 delivers transport only.

2026-09-29 delivery evidence: draft PR https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/350 on codex/recovery-handoff. Bound target fc84ed57c431fd582b08e4ed52cf82820fcd9f69; sealed CEM .corvint/changes/fc84ed57c431fd582b08e4ed52cf82820fcd9f69.cem.json. Two fresh-agent arms passed independent eight-case outcomes; deterministic unchanged/repeat/stale/deleted cases, negative control, scoped Go/docs checks and interruption artifact/cleanup checks passed. Independent source and bound-evidence review clear; local dogfood satisfied, dogfood-check and seal PASS. Experimental only; no savings or full AT-06/AT-08 qualification. OCM retains 52 unassessed obligations and frontier retains five broad-clause advisories. Native claim refused RESOURCE_COLLISION against existing broad docs reservations; no admission or completion claimed. Keep OPEN pending authorized integration and supported native completion; no manual bypass.
title: Qualify a fresh-agent checkpoint handoff against structured notes
